BuySellIndicator.name: Buy Sell Indicator
BuySellIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the order is to buy or sell.

OrderValidityStatus.name: Order Validity Status
OrderValidityStatus.definition: Identification of the validity status of the order.

OrderStatus.name: Order Status
OrderStatus.definition: Identification of the status of the order.

InitialQuantity.name: Initial Quantity
InitialQuantity.definition: Initial quantity of the order.||Usage: The initial quantity includes the hidden quantity.

RemainingQuantity.name: Remaining Quantity
RemainingQuantity.definition: Total quantity that remains in the order book after a partial execution or in the case of any other event affecting the order||Usage: The remaining quantity includes the remaining hidden quantity.

DisplayedQuantity.name: Displayed Quantity
DisplayedQuantity.definition: Quantity of the order that is visible in the orderbook.

MinimumAcceptableQuantity.name: Minimum Acceptable Quantity
MinimumAcceptableQuantity.definition: Minimum acceptable quantity for an order to be filled, which can consist of multiple partial executions and is normally only for non-persistent order types.

MinimumExecutable.name: Minimum Executable
MinimumExecutable.definition: Minimum execution size of any individual potential execution.

PassiveOnlyIndicator.name: Passive Only Indicator
PassiveOnlyIndicator.definition: Indicates if the order is submitted to the trading venue with a characteristic or flag, such that the order shall not immediately execute against any contra visible orders.||Usage: When absent, default value is false.

SelfExecutionPrevention.name: Self Execution Prevention
SelfExecutionPrevention.definition: Indicates if order has been entered with self-execution prevention criteria, so that it would not execute with an order on the opposite side of the book entered by the same member or participant.||Usage: When absent, default value is false.

RoutingStrategy.name: Routing Strategy
RoutingStrategy.definition: Applicable routing strategy as per the trading venue specification.

OneElementPresenceRule.definition: BuySellInidicator must be present or |OrderValidityStatus must be present or |OrderStatus must be present or |InitialQuantity must be present or |RemainingQuantity must be present or |DisplayedQuantity must be present or |MinimumAcceptableQuantity must be present or |MinimumExecutable must be present or |PassiveOnlyIndicator must be present or |SelfExecutionPrevention must be present or|RoutingStrategy must be present.
